input: Resole my worn leather hiking boots

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to resole their worn leather hiking boots, either by doing it themselves or through a professional service.

questions.title: Do you want to DIY or hire a cobbler?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user intends to resole the boots themselves or send them to a professional cobbler or resoling service.

questions.title: What brand and model are the hiking boots?
questions.description: Identify the specific boot brand and model, as this affects sole compatibility and resoling options.

questions.title: What type of sole do the boots currently have?
questions.description: Determine the existing sole type (e.g., Vibram, rubber lug) to match or upgrade during resoling.

questions.title: Are the uppers still in good structural condition?
questions.description: Assess whether the leather upper is intact enough to justify the cost and effort of resoling.

questions.title: What is your budget for this resoling job?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit, as professional resoling costs vary widely by service and sole type.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline, like an upcoming hiking trip?
questions.description: Find out if there is a time constraint that affects whether a DIY or mail-in professional service is feasible.

questions.title: Is there a local cobbler nearby you can access?
questions.description: Determine geographic access to local resoling services versus needing to use a mail-in resoling company.
